title: Redirect-state loop invariance
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $b$ be a Boolean value, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. Every configuration of the redirected machine on $x$ whose state is the added loop state remains exactly unchanged after any number $t$ of steps.
hypotheses_covered: Configuration of the redirected machine in the added loop state
